dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical reduction in lateral body width from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Lateral margins are predominantly smooth and symmetrical with no visible bulges or indentations.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Dark slate-grey median pixel intensity across the dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, fine-grained lighter pixel clusters distributed irregularly across the central dorsal region.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse and gradual grayscale gradients between pigmented areas.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: One distinct, dark circular high-contrast point at the anterior midline (blowhole) and sparse, minute white punctate marks on the dorsal plane.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Visible linear longitudinal ridge along the central dorsal axis in the posterior half.
